+from app.api.handlers import handle_get_user_by_email
+
+def test_handle_get_user_by_email():
+    # Valid user
+    code, user = handle_get_user_by_email({"email": "ada@example.com"})
+    assert code == 200
+    assert user["email"] == "ada@example.com"
+    assert user["name"] == "Ada"
+
+    # Not found
+    code, res = handle_get_user_by_email({"email": "notfound@example.com"})
+    assert code == 404
+    assert res["error"] == "not found"
+
+    # Missing email
+    code, res = handle_get_user_by_email({})
+    assert code == 400
+    assert res["error"] == "invalid email"
+
+    # Invalid email format (missing @)
+    code, res = handle_get_user_by_email({"email": "invalidemail"})
+    assert code == 400
+    assert res["error"] == "invalid email"
+
+    # Invalid type
+    code, res = handle_get_user_by_email({"email": 123})
+    assert code == 400
+    assert res["error"] == "invalid email"
